payload.title: File:Tropidosuchus romeri parabasisphenoid.jpg
payload.artist_html: Claudio A. Mamani, M. Jimena Trotteyn, Fernando E. Novas, Julia B. Desojo and Martín D. Ezcurra
payload.description_html: Digital reconstruction of the parabasisphenoid of Tropidosuchus romeri (PVL 4604) in (a) right lateral view; (b) left lateral view; (c) dorsal view; (d) ventral view; (e) anterior view; and (f) posterior view. atr, anterior tympanic recess; bof, basioccipital fossa; bt, basal tuber; btp, basipterygoid process; clp, clinoid process; cu, cultriform process; ds, dorsum sellae; pif, pituitary fossa; vpf, ventral paired foramina on parabasisphenoid, probably for the cerebral internal carotid artery. Scale bars equal 5 mm.
